title: reference.json: eval ground truth, quarantined from drafting
description: The student's submitted answers to a completed module, plus grading feedback returned after the student clicked Check Answer. Completed modules provide meaningful eval fixtures. Keep this file separate from module.json so lt-module-answer can draft without seeing the reference. Loading it into a drafting context invalidates the eval.

provenance_of_reference.description: Where the reference text came from. Reading panelState.modelAnswer is permitted and on by default through `model_answer.read` (default true). A reference may cite 'lt-model-answer' only while model_answer.read is true. Never store model answers in module.json, so captures remain shareable. A model-answer reference evaluates against the key rather than the student.

student_answer.description: Verbatim from panelState.input: the student's own keystrokes.

grading_feedback.description: Legitimate only after Check Answer. Optional and often absent.
